fragilityClusters.why: Creation registers before the arbitrary prize call, while activation checks callback identities and the factory later checks reported owner/status. Source establishes those reports, with prize honesty separate (Factory L123-L134; Raffle L421-L430).

Range allocation and lifetime counters persist through transfers/burns; settlement needs range membership while claims need live ownership. Receiver callbacks can change owner before buyEntries returns (Raffle L226-L235,L320-L325,L359-L364,L451-L455,L533-L558).
Two price queries, in-flight suppression, returned request ID, timestamp narrowing, strict callback/request cutoffs and inclusive timeout transitions interact (Raffle L240-L301,L458-L465,L509-L524).

fragilityClusters.area: Nominal liabilities and independent asset claims
fragilityClusters.why: One pot becomes either refund liability or terminal allocations, then separately consumed balances; actual backing depends on external quote semantics and prize reports (Raffle L296-L299,L323-L405,L468-L475,L533-L566).

Initial configuration, mint/transfer and quote payouts reuse a current code/registry policy, while burns skip screening and inherited ERC721 transfers are outside the shared guarded entrypoints (Raffle L187-L195,L497-L502,L564-L567,L593-L605).
